dedupe_keys.name: uganda regional referral and general hospitals with coordinates and ownership infectious diseases institute 2018

description: This dataset lists Uganda's regional referral hospitals and general hospitals. It was prepared by the Infectious Diseases Institute, with District Health Information System 2 (DHIS2) as the stated source, and shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange in October 2018 for preparedness against the Ebola outbreak in the neighbouring Democratic Republic of the Congo. It comes as three small Excel files: all hospitals sorted by owner, regional referral hospitals with coordinates and geohashes, and general hospitals with coordinates and geohashes. Files are HXL tagged and free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Coverage is national, limited to hospitals, not lower level health centres. Caveats: HDX states the data are for humanitarian use in Ebola preparedness and response, the list dates from 2018 and the dataset is no longer maintained. Simulation uses: hospital locations and ownership for referral network, access and outbreak surge models in Uganda. Related records: the sub-Saharan public health facilities database (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) covers public facilities of all levels across the region.
